exposure: Presence of microbiota in placental tissues
outcome: Presence of a resident microbiota in human placentas
cohort: 29 women who underwent cesarean delivery without labor at term
finding: Using various microbiological analyses, the study found no evidence of a resident microbiota in human placentas delivered at term from women without labor.
mod_finding: This study focused on placentas from cesarean deliveries without labor and did not make comparisons to other modes of delivery.
